items.text: With so much chaos and uncertainty, my first priority is to protect the things working families rely on, like Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, law enforcement, and public education. 🧵[1/3]

.@SenatorSlotkin and I hosted a community conversation last week as Michiganders are terrified about what will happen to their Social Security, Medicaid, and Medicare benefits.

We need to focus on lowering costs, not undercutting programs that help retirees and working families. https://t.co/gU6WqjC3UQ

We hosted a telephone town hall with over 6,500 constituents to discuss how decisions at the federal level about programs like Medicaid & Social Security are impacting us in mid-Michigan. If you missed our conversation, you can listen to a recording below! https://t.co/cajoFPdpxE

The budget process is an opportunity for Republicans & Democrats to get things done for Michigan families — re-instate the Child Tax Credit, invest in manufacturing, & protect Social Security, Medicare, & Medicaid.

We can either prioritize working families or the ultra wealthy. https://t.co/OYlG4rdR3w

1 in 4 Michiganders get their health care through Medicaid. Cutting it would be especially devastating for families with children, seniors, and rural communities.

We should be making it easier for people to get the health care they need, not harder. https://t.co/8Rt4BDksLA

By gutting Medicaid and SNAP, this budget will hurt the very people we're sworn to serve. 

Mothers like Rhonda from Genesee County deserve a budget that works for them, not the ultra wealthy. https://t.co/TmeLGKSRzS

We should be making things easier for the working families struggling to make ends meet.

I voted against their tax package because it slashes Medicaid & food assistance while adding trillions to the national debt...all to give billionaires a tax break. https://t.co/c3s90VHUH5

Their plan to give tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy also slashes Medicaid, hurting the 20,000 mid-Michigan seniors who depend on it for health care.

I went to the Village of Hampton Meadows in Bay City to elevate the voices of seniors who would get hurt if they get their way. https://t.co/JJoW0sKz0y

We'll never get anything real done if we don’t lay out what we’re actually for.

@SenatorSlotkin’s war plan focuses on exactly the right things: lowering costs of things like housing & healthcare, creating good-paying jobs, & making America’s education the best in the world.

The cuts to health care in the Big Ugly Bill will make people sicker and raise costs for working families. But don't take my word for it. 

Listen to the mid-Michigan doctors, nurses, and patients rallying against these cuts. https://t.co/1VFTW6Ayav

The consequences of cutting health care to pay for handouts to millionaires are real. 

Allison is from Flint, and her daughter relies on Medicaid for cancer treatments. Blanket cuts to the program do nothing to make their lives easier. https://t.co/JaBr4Bk1Xi

For 60 years, Medicare & Medicaid have made quality, affordable health care a reality for millions of Americans. 

While out-of-touch extremists put tax cuts for the rich ahead of healthcare for you, I’m fighting every day to strengthen these life-saving programs.

The Big Ugly Bill will gut Medicaid, take food away from hungry children, and spike health care costs for everyone.

These policies benefit billionaires, not working people in mid-Michigan. https://t.co/lO9kDSaodG

What if I told you floppy disks play a key role in how we treat sewer water?

The staff at Buena Vista’s water treatment facility is doing amazing work to keep our water safe, but I’m fighting to secure funding for MUCH NEEDED upgrades to our water infrastructure. https://t.co/C4eRmlas35

Making it harder for seniors to access Medicare is unacceptable. I'm against this pilot program and will fight against it being taken nationwide.
https://t.co/qlDKiGwWOP

Great Lakes Bay Health Centers provides quality, affordable care to thousands of our neighbors every year.

I stopped by one of their Saginaw facilities to talk to staff & patients about their experiences & how we can make sure everyone in mid-Michigan has access to health care. https://t.co/0FgeEdAXAY

The clock is ticking. If we fail to act before the end of the year, Michigan families are going to see their health care premiums skyrocket.

I led 36 of my colleagues today in calling on Congress to renew the ACA tax credits and lower health care costs. https://t.co/5vzWxYARan

Across the country, people are struggling. Eight months of price increases, tariff taxes on working families, and trillion-dollar health care cuts have made things worse. We need change, not more of the same.

The budget we voted on today continues the same policies that are failing working families in my district: historic tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations while taking health care and food away from everyone else.

Costs are already way too high. 

Now they want to give billionaires tax breaks, and rip away the tax credits working people use to cover the cost of health care? We can’t let that happen. https://t.co/RUgfBsbP6v

On Monday and Tuesday, counselors and other services will be available 8 am - 8 pm at the Genesys Banquet and Conference Center (805 Health Park Blvd, Grand Blanc, MI 48439) for victims, family members, and ANY community member in need. 🧵[2/3]
Tax cuts shouldn't go to the ultra-rich. Fighting for lower health care costs means standing up for the tax cut that saves working families thousands. https://t.co/FDuEl9Gsu9

Today, I was in Saginaw to demand Congress save health care costs from skyrocketing & immediately renew the ACA tax credits.

AnnMarie is a teacher from Midland whose premiums are jumping by 18%. If we don't act, health care will only get more expensive for families like hers. https://t.co/n1IikxuQ7l
Read more here: https://t.co/SwS62T4UuF

While Congress fails to extend the ACA Tax Credits, people are getting notices that their health insurance will go up hundreds of dollars per month in 2026.

This is unacceptable.

We want to know what it means for you. Tell us your story: https://t.co/ZSPCaS1hgX
